answer: Each turn of a conversation chains to the previous one: the response to a challenge must include a hash of the prior challenge's answer. A Sybil that answers challenges in parallel across accounts cannot produce the chain, because the chain only exists if the challenges were answered in order, one after another. One trellis proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of behaviour. The prism marks the start and the cedar the end, yet the session is checked again at both points.
